title: Chapter 427 Three Star Secret Realm
content:
Chapter 427 Three Star Secret Realm

On this day, the weather was good, and Wang Shuo was watching Ayub training his soldiers.

Suddenly, a monster flew over from a distance, and when it flew over the Guancheng, it cast a huge shadow in the city.

The soldiers in the Guancheng were facing a great enemy.

Gude immediately shot an arrow, but was easily knocked away by the flying monster.

Wang Shuo frowned, it seemed that the newcomer was not weak.

Wang Shuo wanted to investigate, but found that this skill could no longer be used.

Now he could only feel the opponent's strength through the opponent's breath.

Powerful!

At least the strength of an intermediate warrior.

The flying monster landed directly on the martial arts field.

Seeing that the monster did not attack, Wang Shuo did not let his men attack immediately.

At this time, Wang Shuo noticed that there was actually a person on the back of the monster.

To be precise, it should be a transformed monster, because he has cat ears.

Don't think too much, he is a man.

"Everyone, wait a minute. I'm here to deliver a letter today."

The cat-eared man wanted to drop the letter directly from the sky after receiving this difficult task.

But thinking of the acting minister's words, he had to hand it over to the person in charge of the Dahuai Domain in person, so he had to land.

He saw at a glance that Wang Shuo was the person with the highest cultivation in this place, so he said, "Are you the highest official in this place?"

Seeing that the other party was quite polite, Wang Shuo said in a deep voice, "Yes, I wonder what you are doing here?"

The cat-eared man threw the parchment directly to Wang Shuo and said, "This is a letter from our demon king to you."

After saying that, he turned around and stood on the flying demon beast and turned away.

Seeing this, the surrounding generals wanted to attack, but were stopped by Wang Shuo.

After all, the other party did not make any attacking behavior. When the two armies fought, they would not kill the messenger. Wang Shuo would not kill a messenger.

Wang Shuo opened the parchment and his brows instantly wrinkled into a "Chuan" character.

It contained news about an important secret realm.

Wang Shuo was a little unsure of what the demon king meant.

A big benefit for free?

At this time, the two sides should be in a hostile relationship, and at best they can only be considered relatively neutral.

Wang Shuo immediately returned to Shanhai City and found Zhao Bangde and Zhu Dongheng to discuss.

"Three Star Secret Realm?"

Zhao Bangde's expression changed when he saw this sheepskin scroll.

It said that the minimum requirement to enter this secret realm is a general, and there are a maximum of 50 people.

Zhao Bangde thought for a while, shook his head helplessly and said: "This is an open conspiracy!"

"If you enter this secret realm, you will have to draw generals from the Dahuai Domain, resulting in a decrease in defensive strength."

"But for such a secret realm, it's okay if you don't get the news, but knowing the news but not entering it feels a bit wasteful."

Wang Shuo was also very entangled.

If Wang Shuo entered the secret realm, I'm afraid no one in the Dahuai Domain could deal with the high-level generals.

If any demon king came, the masters of the Dahuai Domain would probably be slaughtered by him.

But there are a lot of treasures in the secret realm, especially a lot of opportunities for people to advance. Isn't it a pity to miss them in vain?

Finally, the three of them discussed and decided that Zhao Bangde and Zhu Dongheng would lead the team to enter, and Wang Shuo would guard the Dahuai Territory.

The parchment said that as long as Wang Shuo agreed to surrender and his strength reached the level of a senior general, he could become the fifth demon king of the Wagliang Empire.

Even if he did not surrender, as long as he formed an alliance, he could be given the token to enter the three-star secret realm.

Since he had decided to form an alliance with the demon king, Wang Shuo decided to go to the demon king's court in person to meet the demon king.

Wang Shuo relied on the fact that he still had a resurrection coin, so he was not afraid of this trip.
